method: I compared the r_w10 renders with r_w9 crop by crop (crops are in scratchpad/qa10b/). References: omaat_f57, f58, f60 and up_34. Colours are PIL box means, compared as ratios within one image. Code: src/09d_suite.js at 5c779c1 (350 lines).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b MED: the keypad/handset wedge read as a lectern (35 deg, 0.135 above the console)
calibration.status: fixed. Line 171 sets ka 22 deg and y1 0.675, a step of about 0.06. q04 and s5 now show a low module flush with the console line, as in f58. The small triangular end faces still show in s4 (x 520-545); this is minor.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b MED: the leaves started too low, with no plinth, grip slot or chrome strip
calibration.status: fixed in geometry (lines 236-259: ly0 0.16, metal trim, black slots), but there is a new colour problem and a closed-state artefact. The plinth renders in the light fShell taupe, L117, which is 1.24x the field. The real plinth is the leaf's olive-grey, about 0.67x the field in f60 and the same material in up_34. With the doors closed, line 237 adds a proud taupe block under the opening only, so its edges do not line up with the leaves (see issues).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: the duvet fold band read as a raised board
calibration.status: fixed, but the replacement corner is buried (see issues). The band is gone. The turned-down triangle (line 300) sits at y 0.553-0.575, below the duvet crown plateau at about 0.58, so only slivers poke out along the head and aisle edges (q04 crop x 370-420).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: the cap/body hue was neutral grey
calibration.status: fixed. v1 cap is #c3bda8 (R-B +27, was +18) and q03 cap #a39f8d (+22). This is the accepted middle between the official neutral and the in-flight f60 #aaa685 (+36).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: the aisle box and console fascia read too light
calibration.status: fixed. q03 aisle box is L92 against the shell's L82 (1.12x; was 1.7x, and f_17313 is 1.1-1.35x). The q04 module is L125 against the armrest cap's L170 (0.74), close to f57's 0.67.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: the far LOD had no wing or pier wood
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 346-347 add the pier and wing, and v5 shows dark wood at the screen sides.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: the niche header was square and thin
calibration.status: fixed. Line 278 makes the header 0.12, lines 280-282 add r 0.06 fillets, and the back top is at about 1.11.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9b LOW: moire on the far fluted leaves
calibration.status: improved but not gone. The groove is now #424037 (line 19). A faint stipple remains on the q02 right-hand leaves (x 700-930).

calibration.earlier_issue: w9a LOW: the mirrors were stadium-shaped; the centre mirror sat low and was too round
calibration.status: fixed. Lines 109-112 use rrect r 0.032 and give the centre mirror 0.14 x 0.36 at scy + 0.03. The q02 crop shows a rounded rectangle at screen height beside the lamp, as in omaat_f32.

calibration.earlier_issue: w9 out of scope (lighting): hard sun patches, light horizontal tweed, studio handset screen
calibration.status: unchanged. q04 still has hard-edged sun stripes on the bed, and the q03 ottoman is still bright.

issues.issue: The leaf plinth is the wrong tone, and the closed state adds a mismatched block. In both states the base under the leaves and flanks is the light taupe shell: v1 plinth #7e7364 L117 against the field's L94, so the plinth is 1.24x the field. The real plinth is the leaf's olive-grey and reads darker than the field (f60 #2d2e1c L44 vs field L66, 0.67x; up_34 the same material as the leaf frame). With the doors closed, line 237 adds an 8 mm-proud fShell block only under the 0.64 opening (zo0..zo1). Its edges fall partway under each leaf, about 0.18 inboard of the leaf ends, and the left grip slot straddles one edge. In f60 that zone is a dark recessed void (L16) between two proud plinth boxes under the outer leaf ends.
issues.evidence: qa10b/v1_plinth.png: steps at image x 257 and 417, both inside the leaves (x 213-465), with the slot crossing the step. f60 x 370-760, y 830-870 is a dark recess, and the plinth boxes at x 0-370 and 760-1150 are olive.
issues.fix: Line 237: replace the proud fShell box with a recessed void, B.add(gBox(0.01, ly0, zo1 - zo0), M4.trs(hx - 0.045, ly0 / 2, zm), SEATMAT.fConsoleLow). Inside the leaves loop (after line 248), add a plinth face in the leaf material: B.add(gBox(0.012, ly0 - 0.005, len), M4.trs(x + 0.004, (ly0 - 0.005) / 2, (z0 + z1) / 2), SEATMAT.fDoorFrame), skipping the zone between zo0 and zo1 when doorsShut. Do the same for the flanks loop (line 258): gBox(0.012, ly0 - 0.005, z1 - z0) in fDoorFrame at hx + 0.004. The line-250 slots (x + 0.001) then sit on that face; move them to x + 0.010.

issues.issue: The turned-down duvet corner is buried, and the duvet reads as a thick second mattress. The triangle (line 300) lies at y 0.553-0.575. The duvet loft (line 296: y 0.50, y0 -0.03, h 0.065, crown 0.045) has its top plateau at 0.58, inset by edge 0.06, so the triangle shows only as thin white slivers along the duvet's head and aisle edges. It reads as a z-fight or outline, not a fold. The duvet is also 0.11 m thick with a uniform rounded cliff at its head end. The real duvet in f57 / f58 is about 0.03-0.05 thick, with a soft fold and visible creases.
issues.evidence: qa10b/q04_bed_r_w10.png: a pale sliver down the head edge (crop x 170-230) and along the aisle edge (y 470-500), and a 0.11 step at the head end. omaat_f57: a thin turned-back corner; f58: a rumpled thin sheet.
issues.fix: Line 296: cushionSecs(dw, dl, 0.05, -0.03, { edge: 0.035, r: 0.04, crown: 0.012 }) at y 0.49, which puts the top at about 0.522. Line 300: lift the triangle onto the top and inset it, using points [[xe - 0.36, -dz0 + 0.03], [xe - 0.05, -dz0 + 0.03], [xe - 0.05, -dz0 + 0.33]] with thickness 0.010 at M4.trs(0, 0.523, 0, 0, -Math.PI / 2). Keep #e6e3dd. Line 301: lower the drape centre to 0.43 so it meets the thinner duvet.

issues.issue: The centre fin's top strip shows a double line with a dark seam. Both mirrored units add a 0.028 cap strip centred at -hx + 0.006 (line 94). Their 16 mm overlaps have coplanar tops and z-fight.
issues.evidence: qa10b/q02pier.png: the fin top shows two light lines with a dark line between them.
issues.fix: Lines 94-95: centre the strips on the plane, M4.trs(-hx, ...), so the mirrored copies coincide exactly, or use width 0.014 at -hx + 0.007 so they abut without overlapping.

issues.issue: The console module's flat triangular end faces still show from the seat.
issues.fix: Line 172: chamfer the ends by capping them with gRBox(xs1 - xo, y0 - 0.655, 0.03, 0.012, 2) at z -0.68 ± 0.26, or taper the extrusion over the last 0.03.

issues.issue: A faint stipple moire remains on the far leaves at grazing angles.
issues.fix: Line 19: drop l: LAYER.plastic from fFlute so the layer texture no longer beats against the 0.026 pitch.

issues.issue: Out of scope (lighting): the sun patches on the bed are hard-edged, and the ottoman tweed is too bright.
